chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"When the dribble of urine has ceased, then pour the water."

key_terms.انْقَطَعَتْ: ceased or came to an end
key_terms.دِرَّةُ: the dribble or slight remaining flow

ai.seo_question: When should water be poured for purification after urination according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction related to taharah after urination. It indicates that washing with water is to be done after the flow or dribbling of urine has completely ceased.
